_doc: Arkavathi flow-stations config (station-readings contract v1) - PREPARED, NOT YET RUN: indiawris.gov.in was unreachable on build day (22 Aug 2026, every request timing out; the same API worked on 14 Aug). The Arkavathi has ONE CWC gauge with served data: T. Bekuppe (WRIS 019-CDBNG, site type GDQ, lower reach above the Sangam confluence - Paani's CWC sites layer attributes it 'Cauvery/Arkavati'). Verified in the Aug-2026 WRIS availability sweep: discharge (QOB/QCO) served for 2024, level telemetry frozen basin-wide since 04 Jun 2026. To land it once WRIS serves again: (1) seed an empty collection: write {"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[]} to public/data/basins/arkavathi/flow-stations.geojson; (2) python3 scripts/build_basin_flow_readings.py public/data/basins/arkavathi scripts/basin-sources/arkavathi-flow.json (the station arrives via extraStations, its point taken from the API rows); (3) add the flow-stations layer line (readings: true) + CWC credit to src/lib/basins/arkavathi.ts (see the NOT YET note there); (4) register flow-stations.geojson + readings/019-CDBNG.json on wris-live-services dependsOn in scripts/source-registry/platform.json; (5) regenerate the three governance docs.
levelFreshnessNote: Hourly CWC telemetry averaged per month. The WRIS level feed has been frozen basin-wide since 04 Jun 2026 - the series ends there until the source resumes.
